'''Graf Zapalo''' was a [[Human/Legends|human]] who served as the [[Master of Sciences/Legends|Master of Sciences]] in the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]] under both [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] and Queen [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia's]] rules. He was also one of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] most talented oceanographers and oversaw the study and distribution of Naboo's unique energy supply. The [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] porous crust was full of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] that the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] collected, refined and finally used as a clean power source. During the reign of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Veruna]], the Naboo had also started to export their plasma.

==Biography==
[[File:Zapalo_looks_suspicious.png|thumb|left|Zapalo attending Amidala's audience with Queen Jamillia]]
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], Zapalo was one of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] advisors gathered in the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace's]] [[Throne room (Theed Royal Palace)/Legends|throne room]] when the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] launched their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

Following the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Theed]] and the newly-established alliance between the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]], Zapalo led Naboo [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] and Gungan [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] on the development of the [[Mantaris-class amphibious medium transport|''Mantaris''-class amphibious medium transport]] and the [[ER-1 probe droid]] in order to explore the [[Naboo Abyss/Legends|Naboo Abyss]] and one of Naboo's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]].<ref name="ER1">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20010222a&c=rpg|text=The ER-1 Probe Droid: More Secrets of Naboo}}</ref><ref name="Mantaris">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20010215b&c=rpg|text=The ''Mantaris''}}</ref> Thanks to this project, the Gungans eventually [[Colonization of Ohma-D'un/Legends|colonized]] the moon.<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier">[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier|''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Gungan Frontier'']]</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Zapalo was present in the Palace's throne room when [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] came to talk to Queen [[Jamillia/Legends|Jamillia]] about the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|increasingly disturbing conflict]] with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]].<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Graf Zapalo was portrayed by [[Sacha Tarter]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].
